title: Projects
text:
Here are two representative projects from my MBA studies, focusing on
  sustainability, supply chains, and human–machine collaboration.


Featured Projects



  
  
    
      
      
      
        🤖
      

      
        Human–Machine Real-Time Collaboration Framework

        
          Developing a framework for human–machine real-time collaboration to enhance sustainability and resilience.
        

        
          Designed a conceptual framework showing how human operators and AI systems can work together in real time
          to support sustainable operations and resilient decision-making. The project mapped key interaction points,
          information flows, and feedback loops between people and machines.
        

        
          Goal: Improve decision speed and quality while reducing resource waste.
          Methods: Literature review, systems thinking, and process mapping.
          Outcome: A structured model that can be used as a blueprint for future AI-supported workflows.
        

        
          AI & Automation
          Sustainability
          Human–Computer Interaction
        
      
    
  

  
  
    

      
      
        📦
      

      
        Tariff War Impact on BC Fresh Fruit Exports

        
          Analyzing how trade conflicts and tariffs affect the fresh fruit export supply chain in British Columbia.
        

        
          Studied how changing tariffs and trade policies influence costs, lead times, and risks in the BC fruit export supply chain.
          The project identified critical nodes such as farms, packhouses, ports, and international buyers.
        

        
          Goal: Understand vulnerability of BC exporters under tariff shocks.
          Methods: Desk research, supply chain mapping, and scenario thinking.
          Outcome: A set of risk points and strategic options for diversification and resilience.
        

        
          Supply Chain
          International Trade
          Policy Analysis
